items.title: Email Campaign · : Referral Push (30-60 Day Post-Install)
items.preview:
**Audience:** Referral push candidates, 30 members (satisfied, recently installed)
**Why this is the top pick:** These are your warmest, freshest wins. They just spent real money and the water quality difference is at peak-noticeable. No 12-month rule risk, no cold-list deliverability drag. Highest conversion-per-send of anything on the board.
**Subject line (primary):**
`The water thing your neighbors keep asking about`
**Alternates:**
1. (curiosity) `Quick question about your new water`
2. (pain) `Your friends are still drinking that?`
3. (authority) `We built these for word of mouth, not ads`
4. (specific) `$500 per neighbor who switches. Here's how.`
**Preview text:**
`You noticed the difference. Your $500 (or gift card) is one intro away.`
**Body draft:**
> Hi Jason,
>
> It's been about a month since we installed your Ironmax and Ferroluxe setup in Disputanta. By now the difference is hard to miss: the taste, the feel, the no-more-thinking-about-it part.
>
> Here's the thing. We don't spend much on advertising. We'd rather reward the people who already trust us.
>
> So if you know someone fighting bad water, send them our way for a free water assessment. If they book a consult, you get a $50 gift card. If they move forward, you get $500 cash. Refer a few and it climbs: $750 at your sixth, $1,000 at your tenth (resets each year).
>
> Just reply with a name, or forward this. That's it.
>
> Justin
> CEO / ClearWave
*(Product name auto-fills per recipient from the "system" field. Where system is "(not specified)," copy reads "your ClearWave system.")*
**Send timing:** Tuesday, 10:00 AM ET (mid-morning weekday, strong B2C open window; avoids Monday inbox pileup).
**Expected performance:**
- Open: **45-52%** (above your 42.1% baseline; warm, recently-engaged, personalized subject)
- Click/reply: **3-6%** (dramatically above your 0.28% click avg because the action is "reply," not "click," and these people are freshly satisfied)
- Conversion: **1-3 booked consults** across 30 sends is realistic; even 1 close = $500 out but a $8k-11k job in.
**Source justification:** Draws from Rule #3 (referral push over reviews) and the exact REFERRAL BONUS STRUCTURE ($50 / $500 / $750 / $1,000). Uses "free water assessment" per Rule #3a. Jobber trigger: "Referral push candidates (30-60 days post-install, satisfied)."

items.title: Email Campaign · : Concierge "Is It Worth It" (Year 1.5)
items.preview:
**Audience:** Concierge upsell candidates, 100 members (13-24 months post-install, not on Concierge)
**Why:** Second-best conversion play. These clients already survived year 1 and trust the service. It's recurring revenue ($99/mo), and the "here's the math" framing matches your spec's non-pushy tone. Larger list than referrals, so even a small rate produces meaningful MRR.
**Subject line (primary):**
`The question everyone asks at year one and a half`
**Alternates:**
1. (curiosity) `Is Concierge actually worth it for you?`
2. (specific) `$99/mo: here's exactly what it covers`
3. (authority) `You made it a year. Here's the honest math.`
4. (pain) `Don't want to think about filter swaps? Read this.`
**Preview text:**
`No pressure. Just the honest math on whether Concierge makes sense for your setup.`
**Body draft:**
> Hi Albert,
>
> Your Re-Ionator Pro has been running in Chantilly for over a year now. You've had your first annual service, so you know how we work.
>
> The question we get most around this point: "Is that Concierge thing worth it for me?" Fair question. Here's the honest math.
>
> Concierge is $99/mo. It covers your annual service, filter swaps, priority phone support, and parts coverage on your standard install components. If you'd rather never think about maintenance timing again, it usually pays for itself in convenience alone.
>
> If pay-as-you-go suits you better, that's completely fine. No pressure either way.
>
> Want the breakdown for your specific setup? Just reply and I'll run the numbers for you.
>
> Justin
> CEO / ClearWave
*(Product name auto-fills per recipient; "your ClearWave system" where unspecified.)*
**Send timing:** Thursday, 11:00 AM ET (later-week, considered-decision framing lands better midweek; separates it from the Tuesday referral send).
**Expected performance:**
- Open: **40-46%** (near baseline; these are engaged clients but the topic is lower-urgency than referrals)
- Click/reply: **1-3%** (reply-based, low-friction ask)
- Conversion: **2-5 Concierge signups** across 100 sends is a reasonable target = **$200-$500 new MRR** ($2,400-$6,000 annualized).
**Source justification:** Fully compliant with Rule #1 and the CONCIERGE UPSELL CONTEXT (list pre-filtered 13-24 months, "is this worth it / here's the math" framing, $99/mo + exact inclusions, non-pushy). Rule #2 satisfied by naming the actual product ("Re-Ionator Pro").
---
### What I deliberately did NOT propose this week
- **Cold lead re-engagement (1,000):** High volume but your recent "Access Your Client App" sends cratered at 0.2-0.7% open. Blasting 1,000 cold, unengaged contacts risks spam-flagging and hurting deliverability for the warm campaigns above. Worth doing, but as its own isolated week with a genuine water-news hook, not stacked against two warm sends.
- **1-year annual service (20):** Legitimate, but smaller list and it's operational, not a growth lever. Can fold into next week.
Want me to build the cold-lead re-engagement as a standalone for next week with a real news angle?

---
